integrity: The unlimited-parameter theorem follows from run-count recovery and exact factor-pair bijections. A standalone literal enumeration corroborates it on finite ranges. Literature searches do not certify global novelty; no external proof audit has been performed.
limitations: Exact for linear binary words with at most four runs and their full two-gapped two-decks; no assertion about five or more runs, higher gap, longer subsequences, or noise. The earliest six-letter collision and its example are already present in the 2022 source.
title: Divisor-valued ambiguity fibres of binary two-gapped decks at four runs
